title: Holds a lot, weak adhesive
text:
Holds a lot, weak adhesive. Updated review - dropped to 3 Stars

After a week on the wall, with a hairbrush, a tiny tube of eye cream, a tube of toothpaste and a stick of deodorant in the basket, it fell off the wall. The adhesive strip completely dried up and the whole kit and kaboodle fell to the floor. The second basket is still on the wall, but it has only tissues in it now because I don't trust it.

*****Original review below*****

*****You can never have enough little storage shelf things in an RV. These use an adhesive to attach to the walls rather than screws - a must in an RV since they are built so cheaply. The walls don't support nails etc.

The hooks to hold the shelf to the adhesive sticker are stuff and a bit difficult to attach, however, they do hold on. The adhesive is strong and attaches fast - we felt comfortable using the baskets in an hour.

Two days later, these are both still solidly attached and holding multiple small items - hooray for a cleared bathroom sink area! I have deodorant, skin lotion, eye cream, a small bottle of liquid Benadryl, bottle of aspirin and a bottle of allergy pills 8n one basket with no problems.
